title: Havne plugin value fixtures
description: A plugin's value-fixture file (format 1, ADR-0052 section 8), named in its manifest's "fixtures": each value the simulated ECU answers for a variant's signal and a session must read back. Map this schema to your files in your editor's settings: the loader refuses a "$schema" key, as it refuses every key it doesn't know.
$comment: The loader (read_values in core/src/plugin.cpp) is the truth; tests/schema_keys.py keeps each object's keys equal to its only_keys sets. The loader alone checks: "havne_fixtures" as the first key; the size (1 MiB) and JSON's rules; whole numbers written with no fraction or exponent; a variant the plugin has, a signal of that variant that is a number or an enum (not text, hex or computed), each variant and signal pair once.

havne_fixtures.title: Format
havne_fixtures.description: The fixture format's version, and the file's first key. This Havne reads format 1.

values.title: Values
values.description: 1 to 4096 values, each for one variant's signal.

value.title: Value fixture
value.description: A value the simulated ECU answers for a signal, which must come back within half the field's step.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: The id of one of the plugin's variants.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: The key of one of the variant's number or enum signals.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value in the signal's own unit (an enum's raw number).
